title: Porch insight: the Big Bang as a ripple inside a universe at rest, as an explanation for where the Virgin Mary came from

tellings.quote: Was was sitting in my porch with screens all around my porch and picturing the Big Bang for the first time in my life.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA chief who says he is a time traveler, describes sitting on his screened porch and picturing the Big Bang, the birth of the universe, for the first time. He says it came to him as a ripple inside a larger universe at rest, drawing on thinkers like Thomas Aquinas, Leibniz and Einstein, and that this could explain where the Virgin Mary came from. To him it ties science and faith together in one picture.
